resources.string: Press and hold any app, then add another app to turn the tile into a folder.
Swipe up or down inside MinkSpace to move between Mini Apps. Tap supported apps to expand.
Type normally to search, or start with a hotkey to tell Magic Box what you want to do.
@ Message · # Call · − To-do · / Note · + Event · ? App · * Assistant
Tap to open the keyboard. Press and hold to launch Adrift.
Open Messages, check the date and battery, or jump into Settings.
Swipe from Home to reach the spaces around it.
Review Home controls, shortcuts, and gestures
Swipe through Mini Apps, your seven app and folder pages, Quick Apps, and Widgets.
Tap the title to rename this folder.
Tap Home to make this the folder Classic opens first.
Tap + to add, remove, or reorder its apps and shortcuts.
Use the bottom rail to jump between Conversations, Mini Apps, folders, Quick Apps, and Widgets.
Swipe up for All Apps and down for notifications.
